offering_meeting_shape.name: offering_meeting_shape
offering_meeting_shape.value:
CASE kind
      WHEN 'weekly' THEN
        day_of_week IS NOT NULL
        AND start_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time IS NOT NULL
        AND start_date IS NULL AND end_date IS NULL
      WHEN 'dates' THEN
        start_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL
        AND start_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time IS NOT NULL
        AND day_of_week IS NULL
      WHEN 'async' THEN
        day_of_week IS NULL
        AND start_date IS NULL AND end_date IS NULL
        AND start_time IS NULL AND end_time IS NULL
        AND room IS NULL
    END

offering_meeting_day_of_week.name: offering_meeting_day_of_week
offering_meeting_day_of_week.value: day_of_week IS NULL OR day_of_week BETWEEN 0 AND 6

offering_meeting_times_ordered.name: offering_meeting_times_ordered
offering_meeting_times_ordered.value: start_time IS NULL OR end_time IS NULL OR end_time > start_time

offering_meeting_dates_ordered.name: offering_meeting_dates_ordered
offering_meeting_dates_ordered.value: start_date IS NULL OR end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date

term_code_matches_year_and_semester.name: term_code_matches_year_and_semester
term_code_matches_year_and_semester.value: code = "year"::text || CASE semester WHEN 'Spring' THEN '1' WHEN 'Summer' THEN '2' WHEN 'Fall' THEN '3' END
